scope: Source record for the additive catalecticant chart theorem; not a replacement source ledger.

external_dependency.title: On the maximal dimension of a completely entangled subspace for finite level quantum systems
external_dependency.primary_source_inspection: Inspected the primary PDF including its v1 date, Proposition 1.4 and Theorem 1.5, PDF pages 5 and 6.
external_dependency.imported_statement: For complex vector spaces of dimensions x,y, a linear subspace containing no nonzero product vector has dimension at most (x-1)(y-1). Equivalently, a linear map on their tensor product with no decomposable kernel has rank at least x+y-1.
external_dependency.hypotheses: Finite-dimensional complex vector spaces; absence of all nonzero decomposable kernel vectors. The application needs no positivity or orthogonality assumption.
external_dependency.role: Imported elementary Segre/projective-dimension bound, reproduced with attribution in Section 3 of catalecticant_chart.md.

local_deductions: The coordinating agent proposed the first-factor catalecticant and its canonical rank comparison.
The frontier agent verified literal ranks and proved the universal block minima using zero-free contractions and the imported Segre bound.
The coordinating and auditing agents checked the argument within the same generating session; this is not external independent review.
Only Laurent degenerations whose scalar-normalized first map has invertible leading coefficient are excluded. Singular leading first maps remain unresolved.
